methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (chaserhq.com/pricing, upflow.io/pricing, gaviti.com/pricing, invoiced.com/pricing, versapay.com/ar-automation, billtrust.com/products, quadient.com/en/ar-automation/pricing-information, resolvepay.com/pricing). Only Chaser publishes self-serve flat prices (verified exactly, shown in USD as displayed). Upflow publishes a free-forever Discover tier; its paid tiers (Grow/Scale/Strategic) are contact-sales. Invoiced, Versapay, Gaviti, Billtrust, Quadient AR, and Resolve Pay publish no self-serve priced tiers -> monthlyUsd=null (NULL beats a guess). Resolve Pay is percentage-of-advance (no published flat fee and no published percentage rate). Quadient's revenue threshold is £7.8M (GBP) not USD. Compliance sourced from each vendor's dedicated security/legal page and corroborated; only explicitly stated certs marked true. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Chaser
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from chaserhq.com/pricing (USD as displayed); compliance from chaserhq.com/security. All 5 plan prices re-verified exact. Annual ~10% (Compact $259/mo monthly vs ~$233.67/mo annual).

plans.name: Compact
plans.notes: For businesses with annual revenue under $5M USD. Includes 4 users, 30 follow-up templates, 4 automated receivables workflows. Annual billing ~$233/mo.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: For businesses with annual revenue under $13M USD. Unlimited users, unlimited templates, unlimited automated workflows, multi-entity support. Annual billing ~$700/mo.

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: For businesses with annual revenue under $120M USD. All Core features plus dedicated account manager, priority support, assisted onboarding, receivables forecasting. Annual billing ~$1050/mo.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: For businesses exceeding Complete tier revenue thresholds ($120M+ USD). All Complete features. Contact sales for quote.

plans.name: Care Add-on
plans.notes: Optional managed-service add-on (Chaser Care): dedicated AR specialist handles payment follow-ups, phone calls, inbox management, dispute handling, bank reconciliation support. Annual billing ~$402/mo.

limits: Compact limited to 4 users
Compact limited to 30 follow-up templates
Compact limited to 4 automated workflows
Revenue caps per plan tier
Free trial exists but duration not published
keyFeatures: Automated multi-channel payment chasing (email, SMS, calls)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing, integrations, and compliance fetched from chaserhq.com official pages; all 5 plan prices re-verified exact 2026-06-15.
